name: is-fresh-no-db-path-walks-git-state
body: The no-database path of `is_fresh` now pays one `git_state` status walk before returning false (it previously short-circuited on a bare existence check); upgrade if a future caller needs the no-database result on a hot path, by handing in a caller-captured `GitState` or restoring a `db_presence` short-circuit that still classifies a non-NotFound error.
